title: Nuclei Isolation for SNARE-seq2
author: Carter Palmer
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8tvhwn6
materials: Once the incubation is complete, add 1 ml of fresh NEB to the homogenizer and transfer the tissue and the 1ml of NEB it is in to the homogenizer
Pass nuclei suspension through 50 micron filter into a 15 ml conical tube, wash filter with another 4ml of NEB
Carefully aspirate the supernatant and slowly resuspend the pellet in 1ml of NEB
Gently add another 9 ml of NEB to the sample
Gently add another 10ml of PBSE + BSA

steps.title: Prepare Tissue
steps.instruction: Remove tissue from -80°C storage, place on ice, and rapidly image the tissue in front of a ruler.

steps.title: Initial Tissue Incubation
steps.instruction: Add 1ml of ice cold NEB to the tissue and incubate on ice for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Homogenizer
steps.instruction: Clean and rinse the homogenizer during the tissue incubation period.

substeps.instruction: Wash the homogenizer with MilliQ water, 10% bleach, 70% EtOH, and MilliQ water again
Rinse homogenizer with 1ml of ice cold NEB

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tissue using the pestle until entirely dissociated (approximately 20 compressions).

steps.title: Initial Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples at 820 x g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Wash Nuclei with PBSE + Sucrose
steps.instruction: Perform a wash and concentration step using PBSE + Sucrose.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant and slowly resuspend the samples in 1ml of PBSE + Sucrose
Gently add another 5ml of PBSE + Sucrose
Centrifuge the samples at 820 x g for 5 minutes
Aspirate all but approximately 100 µL of the PBSE + Sucrose and gently resuspend the nuclei pellet in the remaining volume
Add 5ml of 0.5% Formaldehyde diluted in 1X PBS while gently vortexing
Centrifuge the samples at 820 x g for 5 minutes

steps.title: Wash Fixed Nuclei
steps.instruction: Remove formaldehyde by washing with PBSE + Sucrose.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant and slowly resuspend the samples in 1ml of PBSE + Sucrose
Centrifuge the samples at 820 x g for 5 minutes

steps.title: Wash Nuclei with PBSE + BSA
steps.instruction: Perform a wash step using PBSE + BSA.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant and slowly resuspend the samples in 1ml of PBSE + BSA
Centrifuge the samples at 820 x g for 5 minutes

steps.title: Stain Nuclei with DAPI
steps.instruction: Prepare DAPI staining solution and stain the nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1ml/sample of PBSE + BSA + DAPI by adding DAPI to a final concentration of 1.25 µg/ml (a 1:4000 dilution from a 5mg/ml DAPI stock)
Aspirate the supernatant and slowly resuspend the samples in 1ml of the prepared PBSE + BSA + DAPI

steps.title: Filter and Sort Nuclei
steps.instruction: Filter the suspension and isolate singlet nuclei via FACS.

substeps.instruction: Pass nuclei suspension through a 50 micron filter into a FACS tube, gently tapping on the table to ensure all nuclei pass through
Use the DAPI singlet peak to sort singlet nuclei events into a 2ml low binding eppendorf tube

steps.title: Store Samples
steps.instruction: Store all samples on ice until SNARE-seq processing begins; do not store for longer than 4 hours.
